definitions.explanation: Without any break or interruption. Describes an action or state that continues uninterrupted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{絶|た}え{間|ま}なく⟦{降|ふ}っている→降る：00839_furu⟧。
⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{絶|た}え{間|ま}なく⟦{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎる→通り過ぎる：02372_toorisugiru⟧。
{絶|た}え{間|ま}なく⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、ついに⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{叶|かな}った→叶う：05303_kanau⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to my ceaseless efforts, my dream finally came true.

notes:
USAGE:
{絶|た}え{間|ま}なく is the adverbial form of {絶|た}え{間|ま}ない (unceasing). It modifies verbs and emphasizes the continuous, unbroken nature of an action. Somewhat literary.

FORMS:
⟦{絶|た}える→絶える：13814_taeru⟧ (to cease) + {間|ま} (interval) + ⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without) — literally "without a gap of ceasing."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}なく⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to continue ceaselessly
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}なく⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧: to rain without pause
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}ない⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧: ceaseless effort
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}ない⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧: an unbroken flow
